The empty-table count is wrong because it compares the wrong ids. Line 23 builds `booked_tables` from `b.id`, the booking id (e.g. "b1"). Line 24 then compares it against `t.id`, the table id (e.g. "t1"). The two never match, so every table counts as empty. In the unit test's data, `empty_tables` would come out as 3 instead of 1. The test never asserts `empty_tables`, so it doesn't catch this.
